newsitem.title: CANADA: Intensity, Renata in merger deal.
newsitem.headline: Intensity, Renata in merger deal.

text.p: A hostile takeover in Canada's oil patch turned friendly on Thursday when Renata Resources Inc agreed to raise its offer for Intensity Resources Ltd.
Intensity said Renata had amended its takeover bid, agreeing to increase the offer to either C$2.30 cash or 1.916667 for each Intensity share.
It said its board of directors unanimously recommended shareholders tender to the richer deal.
Renata made an unsolicited bid in late February for Intensity, offering C$2.25 cash or 1.875 of one of its shares.
The new deal was subject to Renata paying a maximum cash amount of C$115 million and issuing a maximum of 21.5 million Renata shares, the companies said.
Intensity said it agreed to pay Renata a fee of C$0.05 per Intensity share if a competing offer emerged and was successful.

It also said Christopher Investments Ltd and Intensity directors and senior executives agreed to tender a total of 9.2 million shares as well as stock obtained through the exercise of 2.4 million options to the Renata offer.
